prs.author: Genmin

prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects POST requests whose Accept header lists only `application/json` (without also listing `text/event-stream`), even though JSON response mode never returns an SSE stream. prs.cluster_pick_reason: Implements Accept-header matching via a dedicated `acceptsMediaType()` parser that splits on commas/params, honors `q=0` (explicit exclusion) and does exact type/subtype comparison. #2046 instead uses a plain `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')` substring check, which can false-positive on unrelated media types that merely contain that substring (e.g. `application/json-patch+json`) and ignores quality values, so it is the less robust of the two implementations for the same fix.
